detail.longDescription:
Attached: 1 image

One of our ingress pods behaved oddly vs its neighbours. Turns out NGINX buffers request bodies to a temp file, costing latency and disk I/O on write-heavy endpoints like log ingestion.

One annotation would've fixed the symptom, but we wanted the cause gone: we're retiring NGINX as ingress controller, migrating to HAProxy. The upstream project was discontinued in March 2026.

Why: https://nine.ch/en/blog/retirement-of-the-ingress-nginx-project/

#kubernetes #nginx #haproxy #nine
